name: Miko ☆ Star
source:
A novel adventure game based on the hit series "Lucky Star", featuring wild assault fantasies!
At a certain temple, the priest leaves the temple in the care of an apprentice monk.
Coming to help him out is two siblings, and their young friends.
And thus, a week of sweet delight begins for the main character (you)...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037264.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款以热门剧集《幸运星》为蓝本，以狂野突击奇幻为特色的小说冒险游戏！
在某座寺庙里，和尚把寺庙交给了一名学徒和尚看管。
前来帮助他的是两个兄弟姐妹和他们的年轻朋友。
就这样，主角（你）甜蜜的一周开始了……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037264.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
